title: Enterprise RAG Architecture: Hybrid Search, RRF & Security-Aware Ingestion
description: Design an enterprise-grade RAG pipeline in .NET 9: Hybrid Search (BM25 + HNSW), Reciprocal Rank Fusion (RRF), cross-encoder reranking, parent-child chunking, tenant ACL filtering, and verifiable citation generation.

data.text: In production enterprise assistants, more than 80% of incorrect or hallucinated AI answers originate from retrieval failures, not model capability limitations. Dense vector embeddings excel at semantic conceptual similarity (e.g., mapping 'client termination policy' to 'cancelling customer contracts'), but fail catastrophically when queries contain specific SKUs, exact error codes, legal statute numbers, or acronyms ('CVE-2024-38077', 'Form 10-K Section 4'). An enterprise RAG architecture must implement Hybrid Search combining lexical BM25 and vector HNSW, fused via Reciprocal Rank Fusion (RRF), and refined using a Cross-Encoder Reranker.

data.caption: End-to-End Hybrid RAG Query Pipeline with RRF and Security Filtering
data.code:
flowchart TD
    A[User Query + Tenant Claims] --> B[Query Reformulation & Decomposition]
    B --> C{Parallel Execution}
    
    C -->|Vector Path| D[Generate Embedding via text-embedding-3-small]
    D --> E[HNSW ANN Search with Security ACL Filter]
    
    C -->|Lexical Path| F[BM25 Full-Text Search with Exact Term Match & ACL Filter]
    
    E -->|Top 50 Vector Candidates| G[Reciprocal Rank Fusion Engine: k=60]
    F -->|Top 50 Lexical Candidates| G
    
    G -->|Top 20 Fused Candidates| H[Cross-Encoder Reranker: Cohere / Azure Semantic Ranker]
    H -->|Top 5 High-Precision Chunks| I[Parent Chunk Expansion / Context Assembler]
    I --> J[Grounded Prompt Construction with Verifiable Citation IDs]
    J --> K[Streaming LLM Generation with Citation Footnotes]

data.text: Small chunks (e.g., 200–400 tokens) produce superior vector embeddings because the semantic meaning is focused. However, small chunks lack sufficient context when passed to an LLM for reasoning. EnterpriseNexus solves this via Parent-Child chunking: documents are split into small child chunks for vector indexing, each retaining a foreign key to a larger parent chunk (1,000–1,500 tokens). At retrieval time, the system matches on child chunks but injects the complete parent context into the LLM prompt.

data.title: Reciprocal Rank Fusion (RRF) Implementation in C# 13
data.content: RRF combines rankings from disparate retrieval algorithms without requiring score calibration or normalisation. The formula is RRF_Score = sum(1 / (k + rank)).

data.caption: Comparison of Enterprise Retrieval Approaches Across Benchmark Datasets

data.text: To eliminate unverifiable hallucinations, the system prompt strictly mandates that every factual claim in the generated response must cite the chunk identifier using the format `[cite:chunk-uuid]`. The backend verifies that cited IDs actually existed in the retrieved context set before streaming to the client.

data.title: Grounded Prompt Generation Template
data.content: This prompt contract instructs the model to only use provided reference chunks and reject ungrounded assumptions.
data.code:
You are EnterpriseNexus, an authoritative corporate intelligence assistant.

### MANDATORY GROUNDING RULES:
1. Answer the user's question using ONLY the retrieved context chunks below.
2. If the context does not contain sufficient facts to answer, explicitly state: 'I do not have sufficient information in the authorized documents to answer this question.' Do NOT extrapolate.
3. Every single factual statement or claim MUST end with an inline citation token referencing the exact chunk ID, formatted as: [cite:CHUNK_ID].

### RETRIEVED CONTEXT CHUNKS:
--- CHUNK ID: 3e8f4c21-1209-40bc-98c1-118833aabb01
DOCUMENT: HR-Travel-Policy-2026.pdf (Section 3.2)
CONTENT: Employees traveling internationally may claim a meal per diem of up to $85 USD per day without submitting individual food receipts.

--- CHUNK ID: 9f12d8a4-5511-44bb-8877-223344556677
DOCUMENT: HR-Travel-Policy-2026.pdf (Section 4.1)
CONTENT: Alcohol expenses are strictly non-reimbursable under corporate travel guidelines under all circumstances.

### USER QUESTION:
What is the international meal allowance, and can I expense wine during a business dinner?

data.title: Enterprise RAG Design Verification Checklist
items: Security ACL filtering executed in-engine before rank scoring to prevent data leakage
Hybrid search combines BM25 full-text indexing and HNSW vector similarity
Reciprocal Rank Fusion implemented with rank constant k=60 to fuse disparate score spaces
Parent-child chunking preserves granular vector indexing with broad LLM context windows
Cross-encoder reranking applied to top 20 candidates to produce high-precision top 5 chunks
Verifiable citation syntax [cite:id] enforced in system prompt and validated server-side

data.title: Summary & Next Steps
points: Hybrid search (BM25 + HNSW) fixes both keyword and semantic retrieval blind spots.
Reciprocal Rank Fusion provides mathematical stability when merging rank candidate lists.
Parent-child chunking and cross-encoder rerankers dramatically elevate MRR@10 and precision.
Next, we architect the zero-trust security, authentication, and governance layer for the capstone.
data.takeaway: Never rely on pure vector search in the enterprise. Hybrid Search with RRF and Reranking is the gold standard for high-accuracy, hallucination-resistant RAG.
